pharmacology.text: 4-Fluoroethylphenidate (4F-EPH) is a recreational designer drug from the phenidate family, with stimulant effects.

uses.text: 4-Fluoroethylphenidate (4F-EPH) is a recreational designer drug from the phenidate family, with stimulant effects. It has been used as a nootropic drug, and was made illegal in the UK in 2017, and in Sweden in 2018.

sideEffects.en: Reported effects include insomnia, loss of appetite, a racing heart, raised blood pressure, anxiety and a strong urge to keep redosing. Long or repeated use strains the heart and can lead to dependence, paranoia and psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 已知的反應包括失眠、食慾不振、心跳急促、血壓升高、焦慮，以及想一再追加用藥的強烈衝動。長時間或反覆使用會加重心臟負擔，也可能導致成癮、多疑與精神病。
sideEffects.zhHans: 已知的反应包括失眠、食欲不振、心跳急促、血压升高、焦虑，以及想一再追加用药的强烈冲动。长时间或反复使用会加重心脏负担，也可能导致成瘾、多疑与精神病。

fact.en: Phenidates are built on the skeleton of methylphenidate, first made by Leandro Panizzon at Ciba in 1944. He named the brand Ritalin after his wife Marguerite, whose nickname was Rita.
fact.zh: 派醋類（phenidates）都是以派醋甲酯（methylphenidate）的骨架為基礎，而派醋甲酯由Leandro Panizzon於1944年在Ciba公司首次合成。他以妻子Marguerite的暱稱「Rita」為品牌命名，也就是「利他能」（Ritalin）。
fact.zhHans: 派醋类（phenidates）都是以派醋甲酯（methylphenidate）的骨架为基础，而派醋甲酯由Leandro Panizzon于1944年在Ciba公司首次合成。他以妻子Marguerite的暱称「Rita」为品牌命名，也就是「利他能」（Ritalin）。
